scope: Local external design studies before choosing a Windows replacement. Playable hulls are round 172.
owner_direction: Chat: identify discrepancies independently and improve the method alongside the models. Original paintings and all selected views remain available.
method: Gallery painting, straight port drawing and corrected overhead plan constrain construction landmarks. Fixed surface marks classify the first physical mesh and material in the complete saved scene. Native and freshly imported glTF binary checked separately. Marks guided iteration.
limits: The construction anchors are fit estimates, not surveyed final mesh positions. Separate drawings need not describe the same geometry.
Transparent glass is counted at the first hit. A narrow mullion counts as metal. These labels do not establish brightness, roughness or global visual similarity.
Delta’s dome framing and Glacier’s terrace width and position still differ across views. Exterior studies do not validate a playable interior.
